posts.name: DeskGreet

posts.name: Clarity
posts.tagline: Clarity Share: high-fidelity screen sharing

Streams go peer to peer when possible. No install or account required.

Scientific, reconstructed, representative, procedural, experimental, and promotional content are clearly labeled. No signup required.

posts.description: Heliophilia shows you how much daylight you have today, how it compares to yesterday, and where you are in the year's cycle.
